text.pages_rule: 12n-1 supply (12n-1); packed 248 content pages, guide p.5 suggests 251 -- blank padding not supplied at the owner's request
text.page_fit_note: master 209.9 x 269.9 mm is smaller than the 216 x 279 mm trim and its edges carry detail (worst step 64/255). Enlarging it to reach the cut would push its text out of the 20 mm gutter, so the page is placed 1:1: the outer 3.06 mm (sides) and 4.54 mm (top and bottom) of the printed page carry a soft continuation of the page edge. Re-export this master at 216 x 279 mm to remove it
text.content_shift_note: content moved 7.2 mm toward the outer edge and 0.0 mm down: closest live text is now 21.0 mm off the gutter (was 13.8), 7.9 mm from the outer trim (was 15.1) and 9.2 mm from the top trim (their rules: 20 mm gutter, 5 mm trim; tightest page 238, 10.8 mm off the gutter)
text.outline_note: outlined glyphs, text re-laid invisibly (14452 spans); pages 16, 30, 42, 54, 66, 73, 81, 107, 147 shipped as 300 DPI rasters of the reader's render -- Ghostscript cannot paint their patterned overlay, and the outlined copy would print a page the reader does not show
text.note: kept RGB: the master sets its text in fonts that cannot be embedded (Helvetica-Bold [/Type1], Helvetica [/Type1], 48 Type 3 glyph programs); the pack outlines those glyphs so BookVault's font check passes, and their preflight converts the RGB (guide p.6)
